description: A toolbar button that opens a file chooser (Import JSON, Attach file...). On the bar it is a TmToolbarButton - the same classes, labels, Priority and overflow rank; in the TmToolbar "More" menu it is an ordinary entry whose activation opens the SAME hidden file input. The input is a sibling of the button, outside the collapse wrapper, so collapsing or expanding the button never remounts it (the remount of an InputFile inside a collapsing wrapper is what made the toolbar unstable). The chooser is opened by a native document-level click listener, so input.click() runs inside the browser's own click event (WebKit refuses a chooser opened after a Blazor round-trip). It is a native button: Enter and Space are the browser's, nothing is emulated. A cancelled chooser raises no OnChange; choosing the same file again does (the input is cleared before every open).

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Button label. Omit for an icon-only button (then Tooltip is the accessible name).

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Icon name from IconNames. Displayed before the text.

parameters.name: Tooltip
parameters.description: Tooltip text shown as the native title attribute; the accessible name of an icon button.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: The accept attribute of the file chooser: a comma-separated list of extensions and / or MIME types. It filters the chooser only - the host still validates what it reads.

parameters.name: Multiple
parameters.description: Lets the user choose more than one file in one go.

parameters.name: OnChange
parameters.description: Raised when the user has chosen at least one file. A cancelled chooser raises nothing. Read the file inside the handler: the selection is dropped the next time the chooser opens.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: How important the button is when its TmToolbar runs out of room (Menu). Secondary leaves the bar before Primary; OverflowOnly lives only in the "More" menu; Pinned never leaves the bar.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, the button, its "More" entry and the file input are disabled.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: Visual style variant of the button (passed to the inner TmToolbarButton).

parameters.name: LabelPosition
parameters.description: Where the Text label sits: next to the icon (default), under it, or hidden (the text then stays the accessible name).

parameters.name: PreserveFocus
parameters.description: When true, pressing the button with a mouse, pen or finger does not move focus to it, so an editor's text selection survives.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the button element.

examples.title: Import JSON that moves into More first
examples.code:
<TmToolbar Overflow="ToolbarOverflow.Menu">
    <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Save" Text="Save" />
    <TmToolbarFileButton Icon="@IconNames.Upload" Text="Import JSON" Accept=".json"
                         Priority="ToolbarButtonPriority.Secondary" OnChange="@ImportAsync" />
</TmToolbar>

@code {
    private async Task ImportAsync(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        await using var stream = e.File.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024);
        using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
        var json = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
    }
}
